[[Wingstorm]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Bezzr Wingstorm]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Drazach Thicket]].

==Stats==
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of Domination Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of Domination Magic spells (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Gazing Scepter]] from crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Domination Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Destroyer Scepter]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription#Aptitude not Attitude|Aptitude not Attitude]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Domination Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Gazing Scepter]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
